en:
Hah-hahaha! I'm in a fan-fuckin'-tastic
mood today, too!
Sure looks that way...
Hey, hey! Why the grumpy face!?

Heh, heh, I know!
You're all plugged up, huh?

Then lemme give you somethin' to get
things movin'! Hah-hahahaha!

<CLT=cltMIND>Why is Miu in such a good mood?
It's a little...creepy.
Come, Shuichi! To my research lab!

<CLT=cltMIND>Completely ignoring my confusion,
Miu headed to her lab.
Now, let's get started.
Started? Start what?
Clean the shit outta your ears, Pooichi!
<CLT=cltMIND>What...?

Feast your eyes on the latest invention
from the genius inventor, Miu Iruma!
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu showed me...
Are these...sunglasses?

Not just any sunglasses! These have
built-in erotic animations.

Movies appear behind the lenses so you
can watch dirty movies anytime, anywhere!
As a bonus, I included a video of me!

Here, use this too!
I'll bet this'll get your blood movin'!
...What is this?
It's a recording of my moans!
What?

I recorded a voice sample for you!
You're welcome!

A virgin like you would never have the
chance to hear this voice! Hah-hahaha!

<CLT=cltMIND>Is this grounds to file a
sexual harrassment complaint?

I got other stuff for ya, but I don't feel like
explainin' it all. Just put it to good use, 'kay!?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everything in the box Miu gave me
was clearly for...*that* purpose.
Be happy! I made all this stuff for you!
For me?
Don't men need this kinda stuff?

You can't get anything done if you're
always plugged up!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's weird to be handed this stuff out
of nowhere, whether I need it or not...

<CLT=cltMIND>I am a bit taken aback by
how nice Miu is being, though.
Ah, um... Thank you?

Hah-hahaha! See?
Bein' honest ain't so bad now, is it!?

I like how honest you are!
Since it's you...
I guess I can share my secret with you...
I don't really want to hear it...
Alright, let's hear it
I'll listen, but no more inventions
Are you unsure of something?
Your secret?
I don't really want to hear it...

Hey! Why the hell would you say you
don't wanna hear my secret!?

Oh, I know what's up!
Nothin' gets past Miu Iruma!

You're just actin' like you don't
wanna hear it, right?

Even if your mouth says no, your body is
sayin', "Yes, Miu! Tell me!"

<CLT=cltMIND>I guess it doesn't matter what I
say, she's going to tell me.
Alright, let's hear it.
What? Really? You'll hear my secret?

<CLT=cltMIND>Why is she being shy?
She brought it up!

Alright! That's a great attitude!
Now we're talkin'!

I'll listen, but no more inventions.
Will you take these back, please?

Y-You don't want my inventions?
Are you sure you're even a dude!?

Or...did you not like them? Then I'll make
you something more awesome...

N-No, I don't need you to make me anything!
I-It's okay! Here, I'll just keep them!

Then say that in the first place instead of
leadin' me on, you knob-gobbler!
We'll work out the details later!
Okay...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Miu's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu was clearly in a very good
mood as I returned to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>...What do I do with all of
these inventions, anyway?
